name: Sarkhan, Dragon Ascendant
oracle_text:
When Sarkhan enters, you may behold a Dragon. If you do, create a Treasure token. (To behold a Dragon, choose a Dragon you control or reveal a Dragon card from your hand.)
Whenever a Dragon you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Sarkhan. Until end of turn, Sarkhan becomes a Dragon in addition to its other types and gains flying.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Sarkhan. Until end of turn, Sarkhan becomes a Dragon in addition to its other types and gains flying.

needs.what: a one-shot 'until end of turn, <permanent> becomes a <subtype> in addition to its other types': a creature-type addition that wears off at cleanup, on the permanent the effect names
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `add_subtype` op writes the subtype onto the object with no duration, so Sarkhan would stay a Dragon for good; `animate` sets base power and toughness (0/0 unless given), so it would replace Sarkhan's 2/2; granting an `add_subtype` static through `grant_ability` makes it an ability, which an ability-removing effect would strip where the printed one-shot effect would survive. The behold sentence is expressible with the `behold` op
